name: Meta Tags
description_en:
Meta Tags is a product in the Search optimization category. Its directory profile covers Rank Tracking, Link Management, Keyword Tracking, Google Analytics Integration, Content Management, Competitor Analysis, Auditing, Dashboard.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: track reported search positions over time; monitor recorded search positions for selected queries; organize content through creation, revision and publication; compare selected publicly available product or marketing signals; bring selected indicators and records into one view. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Meta Tags 属于搜索优化软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括排名跟踪、链接管理、关键词跟踪、Google Analytics 集成、内容管理、竞品分析、审计、仪表盘。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为中型企业 小型企业 个人用户。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：跟踪一段时间内记录到的搜索位置；监测选定查询词的已记录搜索位置；组织内容的创建、修订和发布；比较选定的公开产品或营销信息；在同一视图中汇集选定指标和记录。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
